name: native_font_release

ownership.argument: Consumes exactly one managed wrapper returned by native_font_create, after all label and native queued CPU glyph references have retired. Matching live manager required.
ownership.return_value: Return value is incidental and discarded. Frees wrapper and updates backing refcount; final ordinary backing font may move into native bounded idle cache, not be destroyed immediately. Does not release separately created fallback chains.

provenance.source: Exact .179 IDA/Hex-Rays inspection and independently rehashed full raw AP function body; assertion font_manager.c:252 font_manager_delete_font; wrapper+36 backing and refcount decrement/idle-cache path as in the reviewed .155 body. docs/native-ui-font-lifecycle-abi.md.

notes: New native UI font integration identity only. No device verification. Return value is incidental and discarded. Frees wrapper and updates backing refcount; final ordinary backing font may move into native bounded idle cache, not be destroyed immediately. Does not release separately created fallback chains.
